instruction: Retain every user reference. Research and use verified design/source material while continuing all approved tasks in parallel. Reference research is not ROM integration.

references.name: Pokemon Heart & Soul
references.note: The supplied website identifies itself as unaffiliated with the creators; technical decisions should be checked against project sources. Website/repository release claims differ.

references.name: Pokemon CrystalDust
uses: Gen III-style Johto layout and tile conversion
references.note: Do not repeat the supplied claim of a fully completed public release. Developer FAQ distinguishes public v3 alpha from the development progress branch.

references.name: Pokemon Legends of Johto
uses: Johto mythology and historical event staging if an authentic source is verified
references.note: User-supplied claims of NDS/HGSS engine and completed content remain unverified. Do not invent a repository or implementation.

references.name: Pokemon Johto Adventures 2
uses: map composition and visual staging if an authentic source is verified

references.name: Pokemon Prism
references.note: The provided Gold-engine description does not match the developer's current Crystal-mod description. GBC data is not a drop-in GBA tileset.

references.name: Pokemon HeartGold Deluxe
uses: trainer progression and region presentation if an authentic source is verified
references.note: Do not treat the supplied Gen I-VIII roster or NDS implementation description as verified.
